# Ansh Saxena — Projects

> Open-source projects by Ansh Saxena, Backend & ML Infrastructure Engineer at Cyware Labs, Bengaluru (GitHub: AnshSaxena05). This file covers URLs under https://anshsaxena05.github.io/projects/. Site-wide index: https://anshsaxena05.github.io/llms.txt

## Case studies

- [SOC Triage Agent case study](https://anshsaxena05.github.io/projects/soc-triage-agent.html.md): open-source agentic SOC alert-triage service (Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Pydantic, NATS JetStream, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenTelemetry, Cloudflare Workers, Next.js) with OCSF normalisation, deterministic MITRE ATT&CK routing, severity-based tool budgets and a structured 6-section TriageVerdict. HTML version: https://anshsaxena05.github.io/projects/soc-triage-agent.html
- [JVM Concurrency Benchmarks case study](https://anshsaxena05.github.io/projects/jvm-concurrency-benchmarks.html.md): open-source JMH benchmarks for low-latency Java 21 (Java, JMH, Maven): lock contention, a lock-free SPSC ring buffer against JDK queues, and allocation cost under G1, Parallel and ZGC. HTML version: https://anshsaxena05.github.io/projects/jvm-concurrency-benchmarks.html

- [cyberSecurity_alert_triage on GitHub](https://github.com/AnshSaxena05/cyberSecurity_alert_triage): source code, README and tests
